name: Kirkland Signature Organic Pure Maple Syrup (Grade A Amber)
whyItWorks: 100% pure maple syrup with zero high-fructose corn syrup, artificial colors, or chemical preservatives. It is balanced in glucose and sucrose, making it far gentler on small intestine absorption than artificial sweeteners or excessive raw honey.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle moderately over plain oatmeal, pancakes, white toast, or waffles. Contains zero fat and zero rough fiber.
